source_text: A total of nineteen Tororo An. funestus specimens were sequenced (5 DDT resistant mosquitoes, 8 permethrin resistant and 6 susceptible mosquitoes)... No polymorphic site was observed in exon 20 meaning that no mutation was observed at the 1014 codon often associated with resistance in other insects.
